basic_info.description: Welcome to 3276-3280 20th Street, a well-maintained 3-unit building located on a charming tree-lined street in the heart of San Francisco's vibrant Mission District. This property features three spacious, full-floor three-bedroom flats and a  lovely rear yard, offering both comfort and versatility. The middle unit is delivered vacant, creating an ideal opportunity for an owner-occupier to move in or for an investor to rent all three units and generate strong cash flow. With two units currently tenant-occupied, the property presents significant upside potential for future rental income as these leases turn over, making it an appealing long-term investment.
